# The Tirumala Verse

The Tirumala Verse is an independent informational and cultural website about Tirumala and Tirupati.

## About

The website provides information about Tirumala and Tirupati temple events, festivals, utsavams, sevas, vahana sevas, rituals, and related cultural information.

## Event Calendar

The website provides an independent calendar of Tirumala and Tirupati temple events, including festival dates, event descriptions, locations, and related information.

## Glossary

The website provides a glossary explaining terms, rituals, festivals, and cultural terminology associated with Tirumala and Tirupati.

## Disclaimer

The Tirumala Verse is independently operated and is not affiliated with, authorized, maintained, sponsored, or endorsed by Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD), the Government of Andhra Pradesh, or any official religious administration.

Official bookings and reservations should be made through the authorized TTD platform.

## Official TTD Website

https://www.tirumala.org/

## Official TTD Booking Portal
